caption: The 'meat grinder' in my skull has finally settled into a dull, throbbing ache. I thought the terminal was just malfunctioning, but the logs tell a different story. There’s a biometric scan of my face under 'Neural Integrity Calibration.' The date next to it is three years before I was born. My head hurts, but the data is harder to ignore. The terminal starts a remote override.
